solutions.explanationMarkdown: Maintain character deficits and the total number still missing. Expand the right boundary until the quota is met, then shrink the left boundary while it remains met. Update the best only for a strictly shorter window, preserving the earliest tie.
solutions.complexityNotes: n and m count text/quota codepoints; k is the number of distinct quota characters. Each boundary crosses each character at most once; result storage is excluded.
